```lean
theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [ConditionallyCompleteLattice G] [Nonempty ι] {f : ι → G} [AddLeftMono G] (hf : BddAbove (Set.range f)) (a : G) : a + ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ i, a + f i := by
  have h1 : ∀ i, a + f i ≤ a + ⨆ i, f i := by
    intro i
    exact add_le_add_right (le_ciSup f hf) a
  have h2 : BddAbove (Set.range (fun i => a + f i)) := by
    apply BddAbove.add_left
    exact hf
  have h3 : ⨆ i, a + f i ≤ a + ⨆ i, f i := by
    apply ciSup_add_le_ciSup_add_ciSup
    exact hf
    exact h2
  have h4 : a + ⨆ i, f i ≤ ⨆ i, a + f i := by
    apply add_le_ciSup
    intro i
    exact add_le_add_left (le_ciSup f hf) a
  calc
    a + ⨆ i, f i ≤ ⨆ i, a + f i := h4
    ⨆ i, a + f i ≤ a + ⨆ i, f i := h3
  hence a + ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ i, a + f i by linarith
```
